_comment: RULE 4/RULE 3 signature data for Find-SkeletonKey.ps1. These strings are kept in this DATA file (not in the .ps1) on purpose: a detector that embeds verbatim Mimikatz command strings in its own script body gets quarantined by AMSI / EDR on load (the detector would trip the very signatures it hunts). The tool reads this file as data at run time; if it is missing, the tool still runs the behavioral rules (RC4 downgrade, LSASS privilege use, suspicious service/driver) and only skips the tooling-signature rule. Edit this file to tune signatures without touching the tool.
